rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Gitee MCP Server enables AI to interact with Gitee repositories through the Model Context Protocol, providing tools for repository management, branch operations, file handling, issue tracking, and pull request workflows. It supports both NPX and Docker deployment methods, requiring only a Gitee personal access token for authentication. The implementation is particularly useful for automating Gitee operations, enabling AI assistants to create repositories, manage code, handle issues, and process pull requests without manual intervention.
